Definition
[normalized definition] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Definition 1\group Kleiner–Lott Surgery Existence

A compact Riemannian $3$-manifold is normalized if $|\Rm |\leq 1$ everywhere, and the volume of every unit ball is at least half the volume of the Euclidean unit ball.
